title: Three Days in Lisbon on 300 Euros
audience: Budget travellers anywhere in the world planning a first trip to Portugal.
brief: Show a realistic three-day Lisbon plan that stays under 300 euros excluding flights, with real prices a viewer can check. Goal: viewers download the free budget spreadsheet at lisbon.example/spreadsheet to plan their own trip.

issues.description: The opening spends about 20 seconds on greetings and throat-clearing and never states what the viewer will get; the actual plan is only announced after the intro.
Claims the flight from London to Lisbon takes about 45 minutes. In reality scheduled London to Lisbon flights take about two and a half hours.
A roughly 30-second story about a street cat the creator followed has no connection to the budget plan and stalls the video.
The same daily costs are added up three times in a row, slowly and out loud, with no new information, stalling the video for about 25 seconds.
Gives costs only in US dollars and assumes US-only references (a night out in Austin, paying roommates over Zelle) for a worldwide audience the brief addresses.
The brief's goal is downloads of the free budget spreadsheet, but the video ends with 'that's my trip, bye' and never mentions the spreadsheet.
